jobs.description:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management solutions, helping organizations streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. Our intelligent platform empowers finance teams and business leaders to make confident, data-driven decisions while adapting quickly to change.
At Jedox, we believe that great results come from working as #OneTeam. We foster a people-centric environment where curiosity, innovation, a growth mindset, and a commitment to executing with excellence enable our teams to create meaningful impact.


Your Responsibilities

As Director Product Marketing, you will shape the positioning and go-to-market strategy for Jedox product offerings. You will serve as a strategic bridge between Product, R&D, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, executive stakeholders, customers, and external industry audiences. With a hands-on approach and strong ownership mindset, you will lead cross-functional product launches, refine company positioning, enable the sales organization, and communicate the value of Jedox solutions throughout the customer buying journey.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Poland
jobs.description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

  • 100% remote work
  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence.
